A '''large serpentine creature''' lived on [[Kohlma]], the burial moon of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. Green in coloration, it possessed eight tentacles surrounding its head which was predominated by a large upward turned vertical mouth filled with sharp teeth and a pair of eyes with slit-like irises. It possessed small spines along its back, and its tentacles appeared to possess suction cups. When cut it bled red blood.<ref name="Open Seasons 1" />

One was present under a bridge that connected [[Dooku's castle (Kohlma)|Dooku's lair]] and a landing platform, and was possibly used as a guard beast. It attempted to attack [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] who then preceded to nonchalantly slice though its tentacles with his [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Open Seasons 1" />
